title: Gemopus-4-26B Large Language Model
summary: An instruction-tuned Mixture-of-Experts model based on Gemma 4 26B, refined for stability and conversational naturalness. It avoids aggressive distillation in favor of conservative fine-tuning to preserve base reasoning while improving tone and structural clarity.
research_notes: Features a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with 26B total and 4B active parameters (A4B). Supports a 256K token context window and includes a native 'Thinking Mode' triggered by specific prompt tokens.

evolution.summary: The project evolved from an initial release to a 'stability-first' variant with APEX (Adaptive Precision for EXpert Models) quantization. While still maintained as an engineering reference, the developer has since shifted focus to the Qwopus-3.5 series for production-grade performance.
